ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the driver tapped "I'm Here" ~5.6 km from the pickup point, and send the driver's account for review of the arrival/cancellation-button abuse + flag_account
ruling.reasoning:
Dispute is a no-show cancellation fee ($6.61) on a completed-cancel flow. cancelled_by = driver, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2.

NS-1 requires all three: (i) "I'm Here" pressed (driver_pressed_here_at = 12:06:15, yes); (ii) at that instant the GPS shows the driver at the pickup point — the trace fixes the driver at 1.30476, 103.85487 from 12:06:00 onward, while pickup is 1.29940, 103.85555. That is ~0.0054° of latitude ≈ 600 m — an order of magnitude beyond the 200 m arrival radius; (iii) a continuous >3 min wait inside that radius after the tap — impossible, since the driver was never within the radius at all (he sat ~5.6 km of road away on Jalan Besar). Condition (ii) and (iii) both fail, so NS-1 does not hold.

NS-2 therefore applies: the rider's $6.61 is refunded in full. Because the driver pressed "I'm Here" while the GPS places him far outside the pickup radius (m_from_pickup_at_tap ≈ 600 m ≫ 200 m), NS-2's extra limb adds flag_account for abuse of the arrival/cancellation button (Ryde's fraud list: abuse of the cancellation and waiting button).

The driver's statement ("waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup") is contradicted by the system GPS record, which overrides statements; the chat corroborates (rider at 12:07:15: "I'm at the pickup point, no car here"; driver's own message at 12:09:15 admits only elapsed time, no location). No GPS gap near the cancellation: samples are continuous to 12:09:25, so the interval can be read directly.

Amount: refund_full = 100% of the $6.61 cancellation fee. The rider's own 90-day record is clean; the driver's profile (no_show_disputes_upheld_90d = 1) is used only as an additional-action basis, per the rule that profiles never decide the case alone. Safety screen: reviewed complaint, chat and driver statement — abusive language, threats and dangerous-driving allegations are absent, so no escalation. Evidence is sufficient: timeline, GPS trace and chat all resolve the elements, no evidence gap.

rejected_claims.reason: The claim of waiting >3 min at the pickup is contradicted by the GPS trace: at the 'I'm Here' tap (12:06:15) and throughout the ~200 s until cancellation the driver was at 1.30476, 103.85487, roughly 600 m from the pickup point (1.29940, 103.85555) — far outside the 200 m arrival radius. System records override statements.

Accepted in substance: the rider says the driver was never at the pickup, which the GPS confirms; therefore the fee does not stand, though the outcome follows NS-2, not the rider's characterisation alone.
